extra-us-marlboro-cjl-kanelsky.note: Rabbi Yossi Kanelsky's center (official, directly under Merkos: owner, Nov 10, 2026). NJ Jewish News, 8 June 2011: the Central Committee of Chabad-Lubavitch Rabbis settled a challenge by Rabbi Boruch Chazanow and Rabbi Moshe Herson to his new Marlboro center (as summarized in data/extra-centers.json). Medium: one source, calling it new in mid-2011; its start is not stated. Not on chabad.org.
